sloka: राघवोऽपि महातेजा नावमारुह्य ताम् ततः ।ब्रह्मवत् क्षत्रवच्चैव जजाप हितमात्मनः ॥२-५२-७८॥
transliteration: rāghavo'pi mahātejā nāvamāruhya tām tataḥ ।brahmavat kṣatravaccaiva jajāpa hitamātmanaḥ ॥2-52-78॥

translations.english: Resplendent Rama boarded the boat and muttered for his own safety mantras befitting brahmins and kshatriyas.
